summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtins feature. Added EndpointResolverBuiltins (str, Enum) with all eleven members in botocore/regions.py. In botocore/args.py, added the EPRBuiltins import, made _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept an absent endpoint config, and added compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults plus a private _compute_sdk_endpoint helper. Added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins to tests/unit/test_args.py with tests for each behavioral criterion. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py, test_client.py and test_regions.py pass (414 tests). Not committed. black and flake8 are not installed in the shared venv, so line length was checked with awk: no added line exceeds 79 columns. The one long line in args.py (line 315) predates this change. The test file changed on disk mid-session; I left those changes alone.
